note: Draft pattern library. All entries are provisional — statuses reflect a first pass, not a completed audit of FusionX InDesign briefs and presentation decks. See layout.html for governance definitions.

statuses.label: Observed
statuses.description: Found in existing collateral but not yet standardized.

statuses.label: Candidate
statuses.description: Repeated across multiple pieces and being evaluated as a reusable standard.

statuses.label: Approved
statuses.description: Reviewed and accepted as an official FusionX publishing pattern.

statuses.label: Deprecated
statuses.description: No longer recommended for new work.

patterns.name: Image-Led Cover
patterns.purpose: Introduce a brief or publication with a strong visual statement and concise positioning.

patterns.name: Executive Thesis + Metrics
patterns.purpose: Introduce the central business argument and reinforce it with quantified proof.

patterns.name: Three-Offering Comparison
patterns.purpose: Compare three products, offerings, pillars, or solution areas within a consistent structure.
avoid: Unequal categories that cannot be compared consistently

patterns.name: Editorial Narrative
patterns.purpose: Present a structured long-form argument with supporting imagery, callouts, or secondary content.

patterns.name: Dark Hero Slide
patterns.purpose: Open a presentation or section with a clear statement and strong branded visual.

patterns.name: Agenda
patterns.purpose: Establish the narrative structure of a presentation.
avoid: More sections than can be scanned quickly

patterns.name: Three-Card Challenge
patterns.purpose: Present three related challenges, themes, risks, or opportunity areas.

patterns.name: Problem → Solution → Benefits
patterns.purpose: Explain a transformation from current-state challenge to solution and measurable value.

patterns.name: Metric Card
patterns.purpose: Highlight a single quantified proof point with a short supporting statement.

patterns.name: Feature Card
patterns.purpose: Group a capability, benefit, or feature with an icon, title, and concise description.

patterns.name: Section Label
patterns.purpose: Provide context and orientation within a publication or presentation.

patterns.name: CTA Panel
patterns.purpose: Conclude a narrative with a clear next step or contact action.
